"import json
import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

Fn_target = 14000.0  # lbf
T4_target = 2900.0   # degR
OPR_target = 16.0

interp_method = 'TABULAR'
thermo_data = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC


class Turbojet(pyc.Element):

    def setup(self):
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(design=True), promotes=['*'])
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(design=True,
                                                  map_extrap=True,
                                                  map_data=pyc.AXI5), promotes=['*'])
        self.add_subsystem('burn', pyc.Combustor(design=True), promotes=['*'])
        self.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(design=True,
                                               map_extrap=True,
                                               map_data=pyc.LPT2269), promotes=['*'])
        self.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle(design=True, lossCoef=0.99), promotes=['*'])
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_elements=2), promotes=['*'])

        # flow connections
        self.pyc_connect_flow('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('comp.Fl_O', 'burn.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('burn.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
        self.pyc_connect_flow('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')

        # shaft connections
        self.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_0')
        self.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_1')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'comp.Nmech')
        self.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'turb.Nmech')

        # net thrust = gross thrust - ram drag
        self.add_subsystem('fn_calc',
                           om.ExecComp('Fn = FG - FRAM',
                                       FG={'units': 'lbf'},
                                       FRAM={'units': 'lbf'},
                                       Fn={'units': 'lbf'}))
        self.connect('noz.FG', 'fn_calc.FG')
        self.connect('inlet.FRAM', 'fn_calc.FRAM')

        # balances:
        #   W        -> net thrust = Fn_target
        #   FAR      -> burner exit T = T4_target
        #   turb_PR  -> shaft net torque = 0
        bal = self.add_subsystem('bal', om.BalanceComp(), promotes=['*'])
        bal.add_balance('W', val=170.0, units='lbm/s', lower=1.0)
        bal.add_balance('FAR', val=0.02, lower=1e-4)
        bal.add_balance('turb_PR', val=4.0, lower=1.01)

        self.connect('bal.W', 'inlet.W')
        self.connect('bal.FAR', 'burn.Fl_I:FAR')
        self.connect('bal.turb_PR', 'turb.PR')

        self.connect('fn_calc.Fn', 'bal.lhs:W')
        self.connect('burn.Fl_O:tot:T', 'bal.lhs:FAR')
        self.connect('shaft.trq_net', 'bal.lhs:turb_PR')

        newton = self.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=True)
        newton.options['maxiter'] = 200
        newton.options['atol'] = 1e-8
        newton.options['rtol'] = 1e-10
        newton.options['iprint'] = 2
        newton.options['err_on_non_converge'] = False
        newton.linesearch = om.BoundsEnforceLS()
        self.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver(assemble_jac=True)


def build_and_run(W0, FAR0, PR0, Nmech):
    p = om.Problem(model=Turbojet(thermo_data=thermo_data, interp_method=interp_method))
    p.setup(force_alloc_complex=False, mode='fwd')

    # sea-level static conditions (MN ~ 0)
    p.set_val('Fl_I:tot:P', 14.696, units='psi')
    p.set_val('Fl_I:tot:T', 518.67, units='degR')
    p.set_val('MN', 0.01)
    p.set_val('ram_recovery', 1.0)

    p.set_val('comp.PR', OPR_target)
    p.set_val('comp.MN', 0.4)
    p.set_val('comp.eff_des', 0.9)

    p.set_val('burn.dPqP', 0.05)
    p.set_val('burn.MN', 0.3)

    p.set_val('turb.MN', 0.7)
    p.set_val('turb.eff_des', 0.9)

    p.set_val('Throat:MN', 1.0)

    p.set_val('shaft.Nmech', Nmech, units='rpm')

    # balance targets
    p.set_val('rhs:W', Fn_target, units='lbf')
    p.set_val('rhs:FAR', T4_target, units='degR')
    p.set_val('rhs:turb_PR', 0.0)

    # initial guesses
    p.set_val('bal.W', W0, units='lbm/s')
    p.set_val('bal.FAR', FAR0)
    p.set_va"
